messages:
Maya: Heads-up — acme-corp-prod reported p99 ~4.5s for text.generate since ~08:15 UTC. Pattern: tiny prompts (<12 tokens) driving the tail.
Arjun: Any logs or traces?
Maya: Proxy log snippet: `route=acme-corp-prod model=model-x p95=210ms p99=4523ms`
Maya: Flame: batcher.wait=4200ms, coalesce.wait=4100ms, handler.exec=200ms
Li: Sounds like continuous coalescing holding tiny requests waiting for a larger batch. Did we change route config recently?
erica_cs: Customer noticed regression after yesterday's routing tweak to prefer model-x-qtz for cost.
Sam: Current route batcher config for that tenant (prod):
```yaml
batcher:
  mode: continuous
  hold_ms: 800
  grace_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 64
  timeout_ms: 5000
  tiny_request_fastpath: false
```
Arjun: Repro steps I used locally: flood with 1–3 token requests at ~30 qps from a single client while injecting an occasional large request. Reproduces the 3–5s tail.
Maya: Quick mitigation idea: reduce hold_ms and enable a fastpath for tiny requests. Patch and canary the route at 10%.
Sam: Also consider lowering max_batch_size to 32 for that route and enable prefix KV cache for repeated short prompts.
Maya: deploy-bot, can we roll a small config patch to 10%?
deploy-bot: Starting canary update route=acme-corp-prod config_patch="hold_ms:50,tiny_request_fastpath:true,max_batch_size:32" -> rolling to 10%
ops-bot: Muting noisy p99 alert for route=acme-corp-prod for 30m while we test to avoid escalation storms.
Arjun: Note for postmortem: when KV cache is cold, tiny requests are more likely to be coalesced; combined with long timeout_ms this creates a single-request tail.
Maya: Canary metrics (5m sliding): p99 dropped from 4523ms -> 480ms, p95 stayed ~120ms.
erica_cs: I'll tell the customer we applied a targeted fix and are monitoring; they'll confirm after a few minutes. :pray:
Sam: Follow-ups: add a regression unit test for small-prompt microburst under continuous batcher, update default route template to enable tiny_request_fastpath for latency-sensitive tenants, and document mitigations in runbook.
Li: Filing follow-up ticket CS-8421 to collect traces, config diffs, and runbook items. I'll own the PM.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: 10% -> 100% rollout succeeded for route=acme-corp-prod.
Maya: Verified stable at 30m post-rollout — p99 consistently <600ms. Closing unless customer reopens. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
